records.title: Main scheduler workflow, implementation and queue audit
records.notes: On main c779b26, scheduler-tick.yml grants contents:write and actions:write, supplies GITHUB_TOKEN as GH_TOKEN, runs scripts/scheduler.py tick and commits/pushes schedule_queue.jsonl to main. scripts/scheduler.py _valid_workflow accepts any file present in .github/workflows; there is no reviewed allowlist. The queue contained one historical entry with status done and zero pending entries. The workflow can dispatch existing workflow files if a due queue entry is present; no dispatch was performed during this audit.
